messages.text: Hey, is this Nicholas? This is Sarah from HeliumDeploy — thanks for hopping on. Got about 15 minutes for me?
It says Sarah ERC here, but it also says awaiting interviewer. What's going on?

Ha — yeah, sorry about that. I'm the interviewer. Sarah, AI researcher with HeliumDeploy. The "awaiting" bit was just the system spinning up before I joined.

So — you've got me for about 15 minutes. That still work for you?
Hello? Come on, Sarah. Do something. Say something.
